title: Amaloboozi Agaweereddwayo Ku Mabbali ga Nabbi
intro: Mu nsi eyali ewala, omubaka ow’ekitiibwa yayolekagana n’okugaanibwa okw’amaanyi okuva mu mawanga agafuga ag’omulembe ogwo. Naye ekibinja ekitono eky’emyoyo egyewaddeyo kyayimirira ku mabbali g’omuddu wa Allah ono, nga baagala nnyo okuddamu omulanga ogw’obwakatonda. Okukkiriza kwabwe okutasalako kwandiyawuddemu eggwanga ery’amaanyi era okukkakkana nga bawangudde amaanyi g’obutakkiriza.
clues: Twali kibinja kitono ekyewaddeyo, nga tuli bumu mu kukkiriza n’ekigendererwa.
Twayimirira ku mabbali g’omubaka ow’ekitiibwa eyagaanibwa abakulu ab’amaanyi ab’ensi yaabwe.
Omubaka ono bwe yabuuza nti, ‘Abawagizi bange mu kkubo lya Allah be baani?’. twaddamu awatali kulonzalonza.
Twasaba omubaka ono okunoonya ekijjulo okuva mu bbanga kituleete okugumya mu mitima.
Mu bantu ab’omulembe ogwo, abamu bakkiriza nga bayita mu bubaka bwaffe ate abalala ne bagaana n’obukakanyavu, naye Allah n’anyweza abakkiriza.
Ffe tuli ba Hawwariyyun — abayigirizwa ba Isa abeewaddeyo, abafuuliddwa abawanguzi okuyita mu buwagizi bwa Allah.

identity.label: Nze Ani?
options: Aba Hawwariyyun (Abayigirizwa ba Isa) .
Ba Swahaaba b’Empuku
Mukyala wa Falaawo Omukkiriza
Famire y’Obwakabaka e Saba
Abalogo abaali bakkiririza mu lubiri lwa Falaawo

trial.label: Okugezesebwa/Ekibaddewo

Okukuumibwa mu tulo munda mu mpuku essiddwako ssimu
Okusuulibwa mu mudumu oguyaka olw’okukkiriza
Okuwona olukwe lw’okusaanyaawo abantu ng’abaana abawere
Okulaba ennyanja nga zaawukana ku kiragiro kya nnabbi
trial.answer: Okweyama obwesigwa ng’abawagizi b’obutume bwa nnabbi

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
